Create one high-fidelity BoardStudio desktop application UI mockup, full interface edge to edge, landscape 16:10 at 1600 by 1000. This is an OPERATE surface for designing ergonomic keyboards, practical and precise. The attached approved GRAPHITE Layout image supplies ONLY palette, type, component character and single-header discipline. Replace its content with the workspace specified below. Do not copy its Layout controls onto unrelated workspaces.
GRAPHITE world: neutral charcoal canvas #15171B, dock surfaces #202329, header #1A1D22, solid contextual toolbar #3A3F48 with crisp #727C8B border. Text #EDF1F7, secondary #AFBCCB, fields #171A20 with visible #66717F edges. Primary #9AADFF periwinkle, selected fill #303B56, component accents #B98CD1, board geometry #6AB99D. Source Sans 3-like humanist sans, Source Code Pro-like numerals for mm and degrees. Flat precise surfaces, no decorative gradients, no glow, no glass, no orange. Restrained 4-6px control corners, careful spacing, clear keyboard focus and selected state. Use reusable Dioxus Components style tabs, accordion, switch, checkbox, select, number inputs, labeled buttons and menu triggers.
Exactly ONE app header about 56px tall; never a double top bar. Workspace screens MUST have compact brand at far left, project selector Aster 42, readable navigation Layout, PCB, Keymap, Keycaps, Case, Parts in the same single line, active workspace highlighted; undo, redo, Saved and Export at right. Fit all in one line with compact type. Project browser and full-page setup use their specifically described simpler header instead. NO floating inspector or Objects panels, NO large popovers obscuring content, NO spreadsheets or new data tables. Docked panels with slim separators. A compact adaptive toolstrip is permitted INSIDE the canvas: one opaque contrasting background, readable ICON PLUS LABEL in a single row, consistent 36px button height, filled periwinkle active mode with dark text. Never unbacked floating icons. Keep main content dominant and genuinely useful; do not turn the workbench into a dashboard.
Real product constraints: local projects saved in this browser and explicit .boardstudio files, no cloud sync, no teams, no accounts. Keyboard geometry and example values are illustrative. Preview readiness is NOT fabrication approval. No fabricated manufacturing pass, clearance guarantee, routed PCB, firmware build success, or collaboration. Minimal concise truthful microcopy. Crisp legible controls at realistic desktop scale, no browser chrome around the app.
